# flutter_passkey_service

> Flutter plugin for passkey (WebAuthn / FIDO2) registration and sign-in on iOS 16+, macOS 13+ and Android API 28+. It wraps Apple AuthenticationServices and Android Credential Manager behind one type-safe Dart API, works with any WebAuthn server, and supports the PRF (key derivation) and largeBlob WebAuthn extensions. MIT licensed. Package name on pub.dev: `flutter_passkey_service`.

Public API (all static on `FlutterPasskeyService`): `register`, `authenticate`, `createRegistrationOptions`, `createAuthenticationOptions`, `createRegistrationOptionsFromJson`, `createAuthenticationOptionsFromJson`, `createRegistrationOptionsFromJsonString`, `createAuthenticationOptionsFromJsonString`. Errors surface as `PasskeyException` with a typed `PasskeyErrorType` enum. Not supported: Flutter web, Windows, Linux, hardware security keys, conditional UI / passkey autofill.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_passkey_service/blob/main/README.md): installation, domain verification, registration and authentication flows, PRF and largeBlob usage, FAQ, comparison with alternatives
- [API reference (pub.dev)](https://pub.dev/documentation/flutter_passkey_service/latest/): generated Dart API docs for every class and method
- [Error reference](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_passkey_service/blob/main/doc/guides/error-reference.md): every `PasskeyErrorType` value, which platform raises it, and what to do
- [Server integration guide](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_passkey_service/blob/main/doc/guides/server-integration.md): JSON shapes exchanged with a WebAuthn relying-party server, base64url rules, user handle handling
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_passkey_service/blob/main/doc/guides/troubleshooting.md): domain association failures, "no credentials", simulator and emulator limits, macOS entitlements
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_passkey_service/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release notes including the 0.1.0 breaking changes and migration steps

## Examples

- [Example app](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_passkey_service/blob/main/example/lib/passkey_example.dart): registration, authentication, server JSON and PRF key derivation in one Flutter screen
- [PRF / KEK article](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_passkey_service/blob/main/kek_feature_article.md): deriving a symmetric Key Encryption Key from a passkey for local encryption
- [largeBlob article](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_passkey_service/blob/main/large_blob_article.md): storing up to 1 KB of data on the passkey itself

## Source

- [Dart API](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_passkey_service/blob/main/lib/flutter_passkey_service.dart): the static API surface and JSON helpers
